note: G45: Lift-Constrained Hybrid Rule Mining and Calibration on FB15k-237

controls.name: C1_planted_composition_upper_bound
controls.must_fire_because: a rule engine with valid inference must achieve MRR=1.0 on a planted composition
controls.can_fail_because: inference walk could miss multi-hop paths or fail filter verification
controls.null_must_contain: an unpredicted or incorrectly ranked query on a deterministic planted relation

controls.name: C2_empty_rule_lower_bound
controls.must_fire_because: an empty rule set must yield zero hits and MRR near random entity expectation
controls.can_fail_because: tie-breaking bug could assign rank 1 to unpredicted entities
controls.null_must_contain: non-zero hits when zero rules are provided

controls.name: C3_metric_monotonicity
controls.must_fire_because: Hits@1 <= Hits@3 <= Hits@10 must strictly hold across all models
controls.can_fail_because: metric calculation bug across different thresholds
controls.null_must_contain: a strict violation of Hits@K monotonicity

controls.name: C4_strict_lift_constraint_invariance
controls.must_fire_because: all retained constant rules must strictly satisfy Lift >= 1.25
controls.can_fail_because: lift threshold filtering defect or base rate division error
controls.null_must_contain: a retained constant rule with Lift < 1.25

falsifiers.name: F1_spurious_rule_elimination
falsifiers.can_fail_because: Any constant rule with Lift < 1.25 survives into the rule base or spurious rules fail to be pruned
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a sub-base-rate constant rule surviving lift filtering
falsifiers.refutes: Empirical lift filtering removes all spurious sub-base-rate hub constant rules
falsifiers.fires_when: Any constant rule with Lift < 1.25 survives into the rule base or spurious rules fail to be pruned
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F2_calibration_gain_over_uncalibrated
falsifiers.can_fail_because: Calibrated hybrid system fails to achieve at least +0.0050 Filtered MRR over lift-constrained max scoring
falsifiers.null_must_contain: an MRR gain below +0.0050 from calibration and soft aggregation
falsifiers.refutes: Relation-specific calibration and soft aggregation improve link prediction ranking over naive max scoring on lift-constrained rules
falsifiers.fires_when: Calibrated hybrid system fails to achieve at least +0.0050 Filtered MRR over lift-constrained max scoring
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F3_literature_parity_certified
falsifiers.can_fail_because: Full G45 calibrated system fails to achieve Filtered MRR >= 0.1980 on FB15k-237
falsifiers.refutes: Sound, lift-constrained hybrid rule engine reaches benchmark parity with standard length<=2 rule baselines (AMIE+)
falsifiers.fires_when: Full G45 calibrated system fails to achieve Filtered MRR >= 0.1980 on FB15k-237
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: Lift filtering fails to eliminate spurious constant rules, calibration fails to improve over raw max scoring (+0.0050 MRR), or full system falls below AMIE+ parity (0.1980 MRR)
